title: Pete's Birthday — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar Italian German language learning warm baritone 104bpm upright bass brushed snare trilingual true story family birthday father character portrait
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
One sixteen AM. Chas texts: Pete's birthday today!!
Double exclamation. He always knows the date.
Mum sends photos — sorry, bottom three are Pete.
Gotta go to Specsavers. Haha.

[Verse 2 - Italian, with English translations]
Una e sedici di notte. Chas scrive: È il compleanno di Pete oggi!! (One sixteen AM. Chas texts: Pete's birthday today!!)
Doppio punto esclamativo. Sa sempre la data. (Double exclamation. He always knows the date.)
La mamma manda le foto — scusa, le ultime tre sono di Pete. (Mum sends photos — sorry, bottom three are Pete.)
Devo andare da Specsavers. Ahah. (Gotta go to Specsavers. Haha.)
Pete è quello di mezzo. (Pete is the middle one.)
Il forte silenzioso. (The quiet strong one.)
Il tipo per cui la squadra corre (The one the team runs through)
Quando le cose devono succedere. (When things need to happen.)

[Chorus - German, with English translations]
Petes Geburtstag (Pete's birthday)
Chas um ein Uhr sechzehn (Chas at one sixteen)
Petes Geburtstag (Pete's birthday)
Doppeltes Ausrufezeichen (Double exclamation marks)
Petes Geburtstag (Pete's birthday)
Mama mit den falschen Fotos (Mum with the wrong photos)
Petes Geburtstag (Pete's birthday)
Specsavers-Witz (Specsavers joke)
Petes Geburtstag (Pete's birthday)
Der McIvor-Kalender (The McIvor calendar)
Verpasst nie (Never misses)
Petes Geburtstag — Pete (Pete's birthday — Pete)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Both exclamation marks are for Pete. Chas was awake at one sixteen to make sure Pete knew his dad knew.
Italian: Entrambi i punti esclamativi sono per Pete. Chas era sveglio all'una e sedici per far sapere a Pete che suo padre sapeva. (Both exclamation marks for Pete. Chas awake at one sixteen so Pete knew his dad knew.)
German: Beide Ausrufezeichen sind für Pete. Chas war um ein Uhr sechzehn wach, damit Pete wusste, dass sein Vater es wusste. (Both exclamation marks for Pete. Chas awake at one sixteen so Pete knew his dad knew.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Happy birthday Pete — from Dad — at one sixteen — he was awake
Italian: Buon compleanno Pete — da papà — all'una e sedici — era sveglio (Happy birthday Pete — from Dad — at one sixteen — he was awake)
German: Alles Gute Pete — von Dad — um ein Uhr sechzehn — er war wach (Happy birthday Pete — from Dad — at one sixteen — he was awake)
